answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks by requiring new identities to solve provable labor puzzles before earning rewards. These puzzles are designed as a computational trellis that decomposes a walnut-sized challenge into parallelizable but interdependent subtasks. Each subtask must be solved at the mesa optimization level, where verification costs scale exponentially with the number of simultaneous identities, making mass impersonation economically prohibitive.
